name: patent-connector
description: Search USPTO patents and applications, read their claims, abstracts and specifications, and view their drawings, using your own free USPTO API key.
long_description:
Patent Connector gives Claude live access to the USPTO Open Data Portal (ODP). Search applications and granted patents by keyword, exact phrase or field, with filing date filters for prior art cutoffs. Pull a clean summary of any application or granted patent (by application number or patent number), list the documents in its file wrapper, read the actual text of claims, abstracts and specifications so Claude can compare them against your invention, and view the drawing sheets as images.

Requires a free API key from data.uspto.gov (sign in, then My ODP). Claude Desktop saves your key in the extension settings on your computer. The extension sends it only over HTTPS to uspto.gov hosts and never shows it to Claude. The extension has no servers of its own and collects no data.

This tool helps with research. It is not legal advice; have a registered patent practitioner review any search or filing.

tools.name: search_patents
tools.description: Search USPTO applications and granted patents by keywords, exact phrase or field syntax, with filing date filters and paging.

tools.name: get_patent
tools.description: Get a concise summary of one application or granted patent (by application number or patent number): status, dates, patent number, inventors, assignees, classifications and recent events.

tools.name: get_patent_documents
tools.description: List the key documents in an application's file wrapper and show which ones have readable text. Accepts an application number or a patent number.

tools.name: get_document_text
tools.description: Read the plain text of claims, abstracts, specifications and other text documents from a file wrapper. Accepts an application number or a patent number.

tools.name: get_drawings
tools.description: View the drawing sheets of an application or granted patent as images (PNG), a few pages per call.

uspto_odp_api_key.title: USPTO ODP API Key
uspto_odp_api_key.description: Your free API key from data.uspto.gov (sign in, then open My ODP).
